_config.stream_algorithm: numpy.SeedSequence(8 entropy uint32 words, HRLD domain, frame, component); NOT keyed by rho or snr

receiver.logloss: mean log2(1+exp(-(1-2b)L)) over 2048 coded bits, L=log P0/P1

environment.torch_binding_authority: receiver context build; verified before first receiver run

c1t.source: 3GPP TR 38.901 v16.1.0 Table 7.7.2-1..3 via ETSI PDF (tdl_profiles_38901.json)
c1t.delay_scale: tau_i * target / max(tau); target = largest delay in samples (60 and 30); quantised d = floor(x + .5); same-d taps merge
c1t.power: 10^(P_dB/10) normalised to sum 1; merged tap power = sum of members; expected-power law (no per-frame renormalisation)
c1t.ray_doppler: nu = 2 cos(theta), theta ~ U[0, 2 pi) (Jakes, nu_max = 2 bins)
c1t.ray_gain: CN(0, p_i / R_i) per original tap i
c1t.seeds: SeedSequence(entropy_words + [C1T_DOMAIN, frame, pkey, 1]); pkey = 10 (profile index + 1) + scale index; message/noise = driver_c1.c1_message (Lkey 0)
c1t.spcb: candidates = distinct pilot_front delays; keep E_d >= theta * (sigma2_rx + 0.5) / (N P_pilot); cap 32; flat prior; D 8
c1t.pilot_front: B0-p2-s0.5 OMP nomination 24 atoms over 103 delays x 5 integer Dopplers => at most 24 distinct candidate delays

theta_spec.criterion: min mean over conditions of per-condition mean logloss_bits (SPcb), dev frames 1000..1099

pairing: all rows of each frame (population: each snr cell frame) share (channel_seed, physical_gains_sha256, info_sha256, noise_sha256)
